location.name: Divided highway across the Ad-Dahna sand belt

scene.provider: AWS Open Data (Sentinel-2 L2A COGs, Element 84)

road.source: Traced by hand on Sentinel-2 scene S2C_39RTH_20261023_0_L2A (approximate, ±10–20 m)
road.note: Approximate (about ±10–20 m). Main carriageway only. Replace with OpenStreetMap: python python/satellite_cache.py --refresh-roads

steps: valid pixels from the Scene Classification Layer (clouds, shadow, cirrus, water, no-data removed)
colour segmentation in HSV (sand hue range, Otsu saturation threshold)
thresholding: Bare Soil Index > 0, NDVI < 0.15, brightness above asphalt/shadow
texture analysis: local standard deviation (5 x 5 px) must be low
morphology: opening, closing, removal of patches and holes < 0.25 ha
